text:
alex.sre: Heads-up: incidentbot stopped forwarding pages to PagerDuty around 21:07 UTC. We're seeing a spike in suppressed pages and 'route_match none' in the notifier logs. I spotted ~18 suppressions in the first minute.
inc-bot: [automated] suppression triggered: rule_id=route-ops-avoid, reason=prefix_mismatch, suppressed_count=18
maria.oncall: I didn't receive any PD pages for the critical alert. Is this confined to notify-bridge or system-wide? Any customer hits yet?
jordan.platform: PD events show no outbound deliveries for service=notify-bridge between 2024-10-11T21:07:00Z and 2024-10-11T21:13:00Z. Checked PD event logs -> 0 outbound.
alex.sre: That window matches. Customer support flagged 3 tickets mentioning delayed alerts. No pager escalations that I can see, manual ops covered some.
jordan.platform: Looking at the notifier-proxy logs, the new routing rule we shipped yesterday is mis-parsing the header prefix: the matcher returns no-route for PD destinations. Example log snippet:
```
2024-10-11T21:07:03.123Z notify WARN route_match none header.x-routing-prefix="pd:" expected="pager:"
```
alex.sre: Hot mitigation: disable the 'route-ops-avoid' suppression rule and roll back the prefix parsing change. Jordan, can you apply the rollback and restart notifier?
jordan.platform: On it. Running: 
```bash
kubectl -n notify rollout restart deploy/notifier-proxy
# verify health
kubectl -n notify rollout status deploy/notifier-proxy --watch=false
kubectl -n notify logs deploy/notifier-proxy -c notifier --tail=100 | grep outbound
```
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook action: suppression rule 'route-ops-avoid' disabled by jordan.platform at 2024-10-11T21:09:10Z
maria.oncall: Sending manual pages for the 2 highest-severity alerts to oncall via SMS while we restore automation. Test page delivered :thumbsup: (sms-delivery-id=sn-42)
alex.sre: New logs after restart show outbound deliveries resuming:
```text
2024-10-11T21:09:45Z notify INFO outbound delivered event_id=abc123 dst=pagerduty status=200
```
jordan.platform: Rollback completed and notifier restarted at 21:10 UTC. Re-testing rule parsing locally looks fine. Will leave the suppression rule disabled for 10m then re-enable with a stricter parser.
maria.oncall: Customer impact summary: delayed PD pages for ~6 minutes, 3 support tickets, manual pages prevented missed escalations. No SEV declared.
alex.sre: Filing incident record INC-2024-5678 and assigning to team-notify for postmortem. Preliminary cause: routing rule mis-parse introduced by prefix-change; missing integration test for suppression toggles and PD event sync.
jordan.platform: Action items: add CI test for routing-prefix variants; add an automated end-to-end smoke test that verifies PD outbound counts after deploy; add metric for suppressed_page_rate.
maria.oncall: Also add a runbook step to auto-trigger manual SMS fallback after X suppressed pages or if PD outbound drops to 0 for >30s.
alex.sre: Agreed. I'll update the channel and link the incident ticket. Thanks for fast triage everyone.
